name: shared-repo-guard
description: Holds blanket git commands in the shared clones for the user's confirmation, with what they would touch; adds /lanes and a /prs pane of open pull requests in the repositories you list, and their CI.

repos.title: Repositories for /prs
repos.description: The GitHub repositories whose open pull requests of yours the /prs pane lists, as owner/repo names separated by spaces or commas. Empty: /prs lists nothing and says how to set it.

lanesDir.title: Lanes folder
lanesDir.description: The folder where the lanes take their heavy.lock, which /lanes reports on. Empty: lanes in your Claude Code folder (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude/lanes).
